overview_description.description:
JELLYSMACK is a global creator company that helps creators Go Bigger at every stage of their journey by leveraging technology and data. Its powerful artificial intelligence detects the most promising creators and helps them skyrocket their social growth through multi-platform distribution, financial backing, and data-driven content creation. Jellysmack's all-encompassing infrastructure provides solutions for the world's best creators to save time, take risks, and maximize their value.

Swann Maizil, Robin Sabban, and Michael Philippe founded Jellysmack in 2016.

product.name: Creator Program
product.description: A service that helps video creators expand their content across multiple social media platforms to increase audience reach and revenue without extra work.

product.name: Jellysmack Originals
product.description: A collection of social video channels owned and operated by Jellysmack that build and manage large communities around specific content genres.

product.name: Media Licensing
product.description: A service that licenses video intellectual property to be used on Jellysmack's owned channels, generating revenue and expanding audience engagement.

product.name: Brand Growth Solutions
product.description: A service that uses technology, data, and multi-platform expertise to help brands reach targeted audiences and achieve measurable results.

product.name: JellyFi
product.description: A financial service that evaluates a creator's video library to provide customized funding options based on the estimated future earnings of their content.
